title: Four-board deployment CFR adapter pilot
benchmark: A frozen learned policy plays at least 100,000 fresh 200bb HUNL Slumbot hands, scores above 0 bb/100, and has a 95% confidence-interval lower bound above 0.
hypothesis: Even an intentionally bounded corrected SRP+3BP teacher spanning four stratified boards will generalize better than the rejected narrow 96-board SRP adapter because it matches deployed financial state, nine-slot masks, and both dominant raised-pot topologies.
material_change: Solve four stratified flops for corrected exact-grid SRP and 3BP at b8/i200 with fixed per-board seeds; convert street-balanced compact data; train a frozen-source postflop adapter with board-disjoint validation/test; gate on heldout target KL, source anchor KL, action-change rate, and paired internal poker before any external Slumbot.
baseline: Old CFR96 adapter: heldout target KL 0.874 but fresh Slumbot early gate -314.7 bb/100 over 501 hands. Corrected pipeline one-board live history+mask coverage 39.66% versus 1.51% old.

code.provenance_gap: Historical record predates automatic patch/source-manifest capture; the exact dirty worktree cannot be reconstructed post hoc.

notes: Stopped the first parallel batch before completion because --use-selector returned four two-tone/disconnected/unpaired boards. Re-run with the deterministic QUICK_FLOPS first four to include dry, two-tone, monotone-connected and disconnected textures.

Initial four-worker SRP batch exposed ESM heap autodetection failure: CommonJS require(node:os) threw, silently imposing 8192 MB per worker; three workers OOMed (exit 134). One board As7d2c completed and checkpointed. Patched worker-pool to import totalmem from node:os; typecheck passes. Parent failure bookkeeping also observed to hang after worker exits.

Completed corrected b8/i200 teacher solves on four deployment QUICK_FLOPS. SRP infosets by board: 13,914,074; 17,103,606; 20,401,056; 15,876,568. 3BP total 10,074,070 infosets and 532.2 MB. Converted 3BP at deterministic street rates FLOP=1, TURN=0.1, RIVER=0.01 to 131,844 compact rows; independent Python replay found zero state/target failures. Added topology-aware BC/BBC v4 distillation encoding and explicit board train/validation/final-test split support; unit tests pass.

Selected epoch2 by lowest board2 validation target KL, then revealed board3 test. Despite strong teacher fit, 4096 mirrored pairs vs Standard10 were decisively negative (-35.40 bb/100 CI95 +/-9.43; BB -54.47), so candidate is rejected before Slumbot. Next ablation increases source preservation and reduces adapter capacity/residual magnitude.

H64/source-KL1/L2=.01 epoch3 selected on board2 validation and generalized to untouched board3 with target KL .2564, source KL .1453, greedy change 3.56%. It passed 10,000 paired internal mirror gate vs Standard10 at +2.33 bb/100, paired CI95 +/-0.738 (lower +1.592), OOD rate zero. Promote to a small fresh Slumbot smoke, not yet formal benchmark.

Post-hoc infrastructure repair refreshed verifiable wall-time and artifact-integrity fields. The exact historical dirty-worktree patch/source manifest and placeholder commands cannot be reconstructed without falsifying provenance; the record explicitly preserves that gap.

result.summary: A four-board exact-grid SRP+3BP teacher produced a conservative learned adapter that passed the 10k paired internal gate (+2.33 bb/100, lower +1.59) and avoided the old narrow-teacher collapse, but 5,060 fresh Slumbot hands were -9.41 bb/100 CI95 [-52.94,+34.12].
result.conclusion: Deployment financial/action parity and topology breadth repaired catastrophic transfer, but four boards are insufficient to establish positive external EV. Both seats are near the Standard10 baseline; losses concentrate in BB flop/turn and SB turn/river. The policy is not promoted to 100k.
result.next_step: Run a compute-matched breadth experiment: solve 16 diverse deployment SRP+3BP boards at b8/i50 with fixed seeds, distill the same H64/source-KL1/L2=.01 adapter under board-disjoint train/validation/test, and require internal plus fresh-smoke improvement before further scaling.
